summary: ḏyr duplicates the damage verb in ḏ̣yr-2
before: ḏyr <Ar. ḍrr ‘to harm, damage’), cf. Turk.  zarar harm, damage, loss, borrowed in Turoyo. The verb may be denominal, the phonological details remain to be explained.
after: ḏyr <Ar. ḍrr ‘to harm, damage’), cf. Turk.  zarar harm, damage, loss, borrowed in Turoyo. The verb may be denominal, the phonological details remain to be explained.
rationale: Both entries derive the verb from Arabic ḍrr and give the damage sense in stem III. Both quote the same İlyas smoking example (Li ǧǝġara ... maḏǝrlali) and the same Sargey prohibition. Their spelling and base-form variants should be retained when consolidating the entries.
